signature: paginate_response(items: list, page: int, page_size: int) -> dict
description: Build a paginated API response envelope for `items` on the given zero-indexed `page` of size `page_size`.
rules: Returns a dict with exactly these keys: items, page, page_size, total, total_pages, has_next, has_prev.
`items` in the response is the slice of the input `items` for the requested page.
`total` is len(items) — the full input list length, not the returned page's length.
`total_pages` is ceil(total / page_size), except total_pages is 0 when total == 0.
`has_next` is true if and only if there is at least one item after this page's slice.
`has_prev` is true if and only if page > 0.
If `page` is beyond the last page (or the input is empty), the response `items` is [] and `has_next` is false; `has_prev` still just reflects `page > 0`.
